name: Mrs. J. A. McGregor
bio: Mrs. J. A. McGregor helped host the editor's party at Wadsworth's ranch in June 1884, and in February 1885 and October 1886 came in to visit Mrs. Paddock. In October 1886 she left for her home in Berlin Heights, Ohio.

Mrs. J. A. McGregor is in from the ranch visiting Mrs. Paddock.
Mrs. J. A. McGregor arrived in Medora last week and is visiting with Mrs. Paddock. She will start in a few days for her home in Berlin Heights, Ohio, where she will spend the winter.
Jack McGregor of the B—T ranch, was in town the first of the week.
Mrs. J. A. McGregor left for her home in Berlin Heights, O. last Tuesday morning. She will return in the spring.
